replies.author: Sevoo
replies.body:
Make walls around, or else kfing would be either easy or hard. Also, kinda seem more like a TDM map than a DTM map. If I were you, I would convert this to TDM, and combine both islands. If you want it to be DTM make it bigger and add some kind of fence thing (Like a patern, for example: StoneBrick and slab on top, 2 blocks, StoneBrick and slab on top, etc.)
For the diamond thing make sure you add at least 9 blocks of dia on each side, that will be 3 sets on each side, including sword, with 3 dia to spare.

replies.author: Pavlo
replies.body:
The maps looking good so far!

Things that can help improve the map:

- Add more arches like this one (the comment I'm replying to)
- Add structures - walls, towers, rooms, railings etc.
- Reduce blockiness? (I't's not too bad, just looks slightly blocky)
- Try add height variation, at the moment it's quite flat
- Maybe add second stories in places?

This is meant as constructive criticism, so please don't feel offended :)
